decisions.reason: The landing-page section-spacing adjustment does not change the implementation stack, handoff objective, or handoff scope.
The source changes general section spacing but does not establish a breakpoint-specific or responsive-layout change.
A local increase in landing-page section spacing does not necessarily alter the shared spacing scale or any other design-token requirement.
The section-spacing adjustment does not change the footer's coverage, visual theme, or link strategy.
The landing-page spacing change does not alter the shared header, footer, or dark-theme treatment for follow-on pages.
The landing-page spacing decision does not modify console-shell styling; the same message's separate dashboard-feedback discussion is already represented as a lifecycle event.
Increasing the gap between landing-page sections does not change the requirement for no header navigation.
The landing-page section-spacing adjustment is unrelated to Actia branding for the sign-in page.
The source concerns spacing between landing-page sections and does not change the wizard-specific portrait, landscape, margin, panel, or progress-node spacing requirements.
